heading: Where Data Becomes
body: From ETL pipelines to interactive dashboards — each project is a chance to solve something real.

projects.title: Automated News Discovery for Digital PR
projects.short: Identifies real-time news opportunities for PR campaigns using AI
description: **The Problem**
PR teams needed a faster way to catch relevant news for pitches. Manually scanning the news every morning for time-sensitive stories was slow and easy to fall behind on.
**What I Built**
- Python script integrated with the **Claude API** to pull and analyze real-time news
- Classified stories as *recent* or *hot* to highlight time-sensitive opportunities
- Automated daily delivery every morning

projects.title: Data-Driven PR Story Discovery Platform
projects.short: AI-powered platform for discovering data-backed Digital PR story opportunities
description: **The Problem**

PR teams needed a faster way to find publicly available datasets, reports, and studies to build data-driven story ideas. Manually researching each client's industry for high-quality, relevant insights was slow and inconsistent.
**What I Built**
- Digital PR research platform powered by the **Claude API** to identify relevant public datasets, reports, and studies based on a client's company and industry
- Analyzes target industries and retrieves high-quality insights from trusted public sources and recent research
- Generates story ideas with suggested headlines, tags, and concise summaries of key findings
- Delivered as an interactive **Streamlit** dashboard, letting users search by company or topic to instantly surface relevant insights
- Centralized research, idea generation, and story tracking in one platform, cutting manual research time

projects.title: Restaurant Discovery Chatbot — London
projects.short: AI-powered chatbot for preference-based restaurant recommendations
description: **The Problem**

Diners struggled to get restaurant recommendations that truly matched their preferences, having to sift through scattered reviews across multiple platforms instead of simply asking and getting a tailored answer.
**What I Built**
- Scraped restaurant data from review platforms such as Time Out and Condé Nast Traveller, storing it using **Google Firebase** and **Pinecone**
- Built a chatbot powered by an AI agent that dynamically queries the database based on user intent to deliver relevant recommendations
- Developed and deployed the backend API on **Google Cloud Run**
- Collaborated with a designer to build the frontend in **Webflow**, and integrated it with the backend

projects.title: AI Teaching Assistant for Online Courses
projects.short: AI chatbot trained on course content to support student learning
description: **The Problem**
An online course mentor received many of the same questions from students repeatedly, taking up time that could go toward higher-value support.
**What I Built**
- AI chatbot in **Streamlit** using structured course content and topic data
- Answers student questions based on the specific materials of the course
- Provides contextual explanations to help students better understand concepts they're learning
- Deployed on **Streamlit Cloud** for easy access
- Reduced reliance on the mentor by offering instant, course-specific support
- [Link](https://rubber-ducky.streamlit.app/)

projects.title: Automated Public Financial Data Pipeline
projects.short: Automates collection of financial data from major global institutions
description: **The Problem**

A fintech company needed reliable macroeconomic data from multiple institutions to power its platform, but sourcing and updating it manually meant repetitive work pulling data from disparate sources in inconsistent formats.
**What I Built**
- **Python** script to automate retrieval of publicly available financial data
- Integrated with APIs from organizations such as *International Monetary Fund*, *Eurostat*, *OECD*, and *World Bank*
- Standardized and consolidated data from multiple sources into a unified format
- Enabled faster analysis and easier access to reliable financial indicators

projects.title: OpenClaw Discord Bot
projects.short: AI-powered Discord bot for daily trading insights and forecast
description: **The Problem**
I needed real-time visibility into currency price movements to inform trading decisions, but manually checking the internet each time was inefficient and unsustainable.
**What I Built**
- AI agent using **OpenClaw** that searches currency exchange trends and market developments on request or on a schedule
- Pulls and analyzes latest news, current market conditions, and future outlook for selected currencies
- Connected to **Discord** to deliver updates in a simple, real-time interface
- Automated daily message delivery using a cron job at a scheduled time
